reason: I would add the bot and use the 30 free documents, since it costs nothing. With receipts landing in three or four groups every day, those 30 are gone in about a week, and then I am paying another monthly bill for something my staff may already have stopped bothering with.
objection: My staff and I are not sure we will keep using it after the free part. And with this many receipts I would probably go over 100 a month, so it is really $35, not $19.
would_change_my_mind: If during the free part my staff kept sending receipts without me chasing them, and it caught a duplicate or a wrong total that saved me real money, I would pay the $19.
